string.text: Real Time Zone (RTZ) -- Seasons of the Zone Addon

Synchronizes the Zone with reality. Enforces a 1:1 real-time flow (1 real second = 1 in-game second), matches the in-game clock to your real-world wall clock, syncs the weather cycle directly to live meteorological observations from Open-Meteo, and redesigns sleep into real-time resting at beds and campfires.
Master toggle for all RTZ features.
Sync In-Game Clock with Real Time
On load and level changes, aligns the in-game clock directly with your computer's real-world OS time (hour and minute).
Locks the time factor so in-game time passes at the exact speed of real time (1 real second = 1 in-game second). Prevents surges or other mods from resetting the time factor to 6x.
Target time factor. Default is 1.0 (true real time). 2.0 = twice real speed. Vanilla Anomaly is 6.0.
Strictly guards hunger, thirst, sleep, health, and emission timers whenever the in-game clock synchronizes with real time so vitals are left 100% untouched by clock jumps.

Ensures Sleep, A-Life squad movement/idle timers, Smart Terrain respawns (Vanilla & ZCP), and Emission intervals continue to progress at the exact same real-world rate as vanilla Anomaly (time factor 6.0) even while the world clock runs at 1:1 real time.

Controls how Hunger and Thirst drain while playing in real time:
- Vanilla Speed (6x): Hunger and Thirst drain at vanilla Anomaly speed.
- Real-Time Speed (1:1): Hunger and Thirst drain 6x slower in real time, matching the 1:1 clock.
- Disabled (No Eat / Drink): Locks hunger and thirst at 100% full so the protagonist never needs to eat or drink.

Controls how often Emissions and Psi-Storms occur in real time:
- Vanilla Scaled (2-4 Hours): Scales Anomaly's emission frequency setting to real time.
- 6-12 Hours: Once every 6 to 12 real hours.
- 12-24 Hours: Once every 12 to 24 real hours.
- 1-2 Days: Once every 24 to 48 real hours.
- 2-4 Days: Once every 48 to 96 real hours.

Emissions and psi-storms last as long as vanilla, but the game clock is no longer sped up 10x, so it stays in step with real time. The emission sky still builds up at vanilla pace. Turn off to use the vanilla sped-up emission.

Fixes the X-Ray Engine C++ quirk where medkits, bandages, and drug boosters only heal 1/6th of their intended value at 1:1 time factor, and fixes gravitational anomaly camera shake (DAO / Arrival), psy-health recovery, and alcohol decay lasting 6x too long.
Drives the in-game weather cycle (clear, partly, cloudy, foggy, rain, storm) directly from your configured Seasons of the Zone location (Open-Meteo) instead of random probability.
How frequently to verify whether real-world weather has changed.
Replaces instant multi-hour sleep time-skips with real-time resting. The screen fades dark while your fatigue recharges over a few real minutes without breaking the clock sync.
How many real minutes it takes to recover from complete exhaustion to fully rested at a bed. Default is 5 minutes (max 10 minutes).
Sitting or idling near a lit campfire slowly recharges your fatigue in real time, encouraging relaxing at safe encampments.
Fatigue recovery points per second when resting near a lit campfire (default 6, max 12; always slower than a sleeping bag or bed).
Instantly wakes the player if attacked, taking damage, or if nearby hostile threats approach.
Creates an autosave when completing or exiting a rest session.
